name: Warehouse — Package Sorting
tagline: Deliver each package to the matching outbound.
narrative:
Two packages travel through the same 11×5 warehouse loop: one red and one blue. The robot already knows how to move and pick up packages.

The missing decision is where to unload. The controller must check both the package type and the outbound type before it delivers.
objective: Deliver the red package to Red Outbound and the blue package to Blue Outbound.
learningObjective: Combine two facts — cargo type and delivery-zone type — in one decision.
intelligenceExplanation:
Movement and pickup are already supplied. Add one delivery rule for red cargo at Red Outbound and another for blue cargo at Blue Outbound.

Keep both delivery rules above navigation so the robot unloads before it leaves a matching station. A delivery to the wrong station is harmless, but it does not solve the sorting task.
hint: Create red and blue delivery rules, then place both above the clear-aisle movement rule.
hints: The robot can sense both the outbound colour beneath it and the cargo colour it carries.
Combine deliveryRedHere with carryingRed, then repeat the pattern for blue.
Place both typed delivery rules above navigation so they run before the robot steps away.
brief: Deliver each coloured package to its matching outbound lane.
context: Navigation and pickup are already provided; the missing policy is type-aware unloading.

steps.label: Deliver the first correctly matched package

goals.description: Deliver every package to the correctly typed outbound.

rules.description: Load a package when capacity is free.
Turn right at the end of an aisle.
